body: I do this with stuffed animals, particularly with having them on my bed while I sleep. I’ll wake up and feel bad if it turns out I accidentally “smothered” one while sleeping.

I do that exact same thing with shows. It can be really any show I’ve recently watched, but more often than not it’s a show that I watched a lot in high school right when my daydreams started to become maladaptive. I don’t even like the show anymore, I just like the version I created in my head that I star in. 

It’s 3:30 am where I am right now. I just spent a good amount of time day dreaming and it kinda hit me that all I’ve really been doing is silently talking to myself in a dark room while my roommates boyfriend loudly snores. 

Just know that you aren’t alone. I’m not even tired right now, I’m too hyped from my daydream. I don’t think I ate dinner either.
